ios.desc:
Want a bite? India's No. 1 food delivery app has you covered.
From everyday favourites to little treats that make your day, your next good meal is just a few taps away. Order from over 4 lakh restaurant menus, discover top-rated restaurants and dishes, and find your favourites in just a few taps. With lightning-fast delivery, easy order tracking and plenty of options to choose from, Zomato makes getting the food you love simple.

A few features worth discovering:

Veg Mode: Whether you're vegetarian every day or just today, discover veg-friendly restaurants and dishes with ease. Less time figuring out what to eat.

AI-Assisted Food Ordering: Some things are easier said than typed. Tell AI what you're in the mood for in your preferred language or dialect, and let it help you find your next meal and place your order.

Healthy Mode: When you want to know what’s on your plate. Explore healthy dishes with nutritional information in Healthy Mode.

Schedule Your Order: One less thing to figure out each day. Plan your meals in advance and get them delivered right on time.

Multi-Restaurant Ordering: When everyone’s got a different place they want to order from, Zomato makes sure you don’t get it wrong. Order from multiple restaurants in one seamless checkout.

quotes.text:
In the latest iOS update of the app, Zomato writes “With this update, we will start displaying a warning banner and clearly indicate a restaurant which engages in monetary/material methods in exchange for biased reviews from Zomato.”

Link to the app: https://itunes.apple.com/al/app/zomato-food-restaurants/id434613896?mt=8
quotes.title: Zomato now openly allows restaurant to pay for biased reviews
